prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: one standalone horizontal 3:2 catalog illustration for RPK.KZ, category "retail islands and point-of-sale displays".
Primary request: replace the one real-world shopping-mall photo that does not match the rest of the catalog with a premium realistic product visualization belonging to its graphite / black / warm orange illustration series.
Subject: a compact professional retail island, viewed from a slightly elevated three-quarter architectural angle. L-shaped charcoal retail counter on a low platform, one glazed merchandise showcase with clean physically correct glass edges, an upright point-of-sale shelving display with a few neutral unbranded packages, and a small integrated brand lightbox/fascia held by credible slim supports. Show the construction and point of use clearly, not just a generic reception desk. All counters, feet, shelving and sign supports must connect correctly.
Scene/backdrop: dark graphite seamless studio / architectural display floor with a subtle shadow and a calm charcoal background, the complete island occupies the image with breathing room on every side. No giant shopping mall, no people.
Style/medium: premium photorealistic architectural product rendering, realistic matte charcoal panels, brushed aluminum, glass, precise joints, restrained soft studio light. Match neighboring catalog assets showing black/orange modular exhibition stands and graphite reception identity. Real material detail, not a flat vector cartoon.
Color palette: charcoal black and graphite, pale neutral product packages, restrained orange #ff8a00 inset front panels and edge accents, one softly illuminated neutral panel. Dark overall value.
Composition: single coherent scene, full object contained, readable on a small 3:2 catalog card. Clean silhouette, moderate perspective, no severe wide-angle distortion, no collage.
Text: no readable text, no brand names, no watermarks, no typography overlay.
Avoid: red retail fascia, Needstop branding, existing company trademarks, cacti, neon futuristic effects, a white background, disconnected supports, floating furniture or impossible joins.
